info.title: gitcloud-full
info.description: GitCloud enhances Nextcloud's file management by integrating fundamental Git version control capabilities directly into the UI.

post.summary: Commits staged file changes using a provided message.

files.description: File paths, relative to the user's storage, to stage and commit.

confirmed.description: Whether the user has already confirmed committing file(s) that exceed the configured size limit under "warn" enforcement mode. Ignored in "block" mode, which always rejects an oversized file outright regardless of this flag.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: Commit successful (status "success"), or awaiting confirmation of oversized file(s) in warn mode (status "warning", nothing committed yet).

400.description: Missing or invalid data, or the commit failed.

post.summary: Permanently deletes the current user's Git history (the whole repository is reinitialized) and every recorded snapshot row for them. Working tree files are left untouched. This cannot be undone.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: The repository path could not be resolved, or the deletion failed.

get.summary: Returns live dashboard stats (file/dir counts, total size, Git status) for the current user's GitCloud repository. When $directory is given, the total size and Git status are scoped to that directory's still-existing committed files instead of the whole repository; dirCount is not meaningful for a single directory and is always 0 in that case.

parameters.name: directory
parameters.description: Directory path (as returned by /directories) to scope stats to; empty for the whole repository.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: Repository path could not be resolved or read.

get.summary: Returns the directories the current user has ever committed files under, each with the list of files tracked in it and each file's status relative to HEAD ('Modified'/'Unchanged'), for the dashboard's committed-directories list. A subfolder (not the repository root) that already has at least one committed file also surfaces any other files sitting in it that have never been committed, tagged 'Uncommitted', so newly added files aren't invisible until a user manually commits them. A committed file that no longer exists because it was deleted outside GitCloud (and auto-committed as such, see GitTrackedNodeDeletedListener) is kept in the list tagged 'Deleted' instead of being silently dropped, so its history stays reachable/restorable.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: Repository path could not be resolved.

get.summary: Returns the snapshot history for a single file, newest first.

parameters.name: filePath
parameters.description: File path, relative to the user's storage, to fetch snapshots for.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: Missing file path, or the file could not be resolved.

post.summary: Rolls back a single file to a previously recorded snapshot.

filePath.description: File path, relative to the user's storage, to roll back.

snapshotId.description: ID of the snapshot to restore the file to.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: Missing or invalid data, or the rollback failed.

post.summary: Saves the admin-configured max file size and enforcement mode.

maxFileSizeMb.description: Maximum size, in megabytes, a single file may be to be committed.

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

401.description: Current user is not logged in

403.description: Logged in account must be an admin
